billing.description: How power is billed to tenants.

power_margin.description: Landlord margin on power as a FRACTION of cost; meaningful only under all_in / breakered billing.

stated_annual_power_cost.description: The operator's stated annual utility bill, when known. Takes precedence over the computed figure, except under metered_pass_through, where the landlord's power cost is zero.

metered_annual_kwh.description: Metered or measured annual facility consumption, in kWh. When stated it is the energy the power-cost metrics use; never inferred.

draw_factor.description: Average share of contracted IT load the tenants draw, a FRACTION. Required to compute power cost without metered kWh; the metrics never assume full draw.
